'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matthew Gowitts DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Gowitts]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time|V1-D-imperialentanglements.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Garbage
* '''Username:''' Mr. G
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
